page.overview:
What is Auric Patricians?

The Auric Patricians is a Codex Astartes-compliant, Loyalist Space Marine Chapter of unknown Founding and genetic origin.

The Auric Patricians primarily wear golden power armour. The power pack, shoulder plates, gauntlets and knee guards are black. The shoulder plates are trimmed in gold. The Aquila or Imperialis on the chest is silver.

The golden squad tactical specialty symbol -- battleline, close support, fire support, Veteran or command -- is indicated on the right shoulder plate.

A golden Low Gothic numeral on the left knee guard indicates squad number.
